name: docx-to-markdown
description: Move Word documents into a notes app, wiki, static site or Git repository as clean Markdown: headings, bold and italic, lists (including nested ones), tables, links, quotes and code come across, and embedded pictures are saved into an images folder with working relative links. Convert many files at once and rename the outputs. Runs locally; no upload or API keys.

description_i18n.en: Move Word documents into a notes app, wiki, static site or Git repository as clean Markdown: headings, bold and italic, lists (including nested ones), tables, links, quotes and code come across, and embedded pictures are saved into an images folder with working relative links. Convert many files at once and rename the outputs. Runs locally; no upload or API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 Word 文档转成干净的 Markdown，放进笔记软件、知识库、静态网站或 Git 仓库：标题、粗体斜体、列表（含多级）、表格、链接、引用和代码都会保留，文档里的图片会存到图片文件夹，并用相对路径正确链接。可以一次转换多个文件，输出文件名可改。在本地运行，不上传文件，无需 API 密钥。
